name: Ki Resilience (Ki)
body:
Your strength of mind and strength of body are one.

Prerequisite(s): Con 13, Wis 13, ki pool class feature or Ki Meditation

Benefit(s): As a full-round action, you can spend 1 point from your ki pool to gain 1d6 temporary hit points, plus 1 hit point per ki feat you possess, including this one. These temporary hit points do not stack with any other temporary hit points and last for a number of hours equal to your Wisdom modifier or until expended.
